units.source_text: 这盘棋，名人的白130，是偶尔失着，这一手是致命伤。

en.t: In this game, the Master's White 130 was an occasional misplay, and that move proved fatal.

units.source_text: 如果不是名人下了败着，形势或是很难判断，或是继续细棋下去，

en.t: If the Master had not played the losing move, the situation might have been very hard to judge, or the close game might have continued,

units.source_text: 七段就有可能更加需要绞尽脑汁，坚持到满四十个小时。

en.t: and the seventh dan might have had to rack his brains even more and hold out until the full forty hours.
After White 130, Black's victory was already assured.
